note: Tool names follow the names fixed in the toolkit specification rather than the <prefix>_<verbNoun> convention; see AGENTS.md. annotations mirror packages/mcp/src/annotations.ts.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search API symbols, page titles and, once docs_index has run, full page sections by words, returning signatures and docs URLs.

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Fetch a developer.runescape.com page live with a local ETag cache and return its text or one section.

tools.name: docs_index
tools.description: Build the per-user full-text index of the documentation pages so docs_search can answer intent queries.

tools.name: api_lookup
tools.description: Return the LuaLS signature, stub file and docs URL for an API symbol.

tools.name: manifest_validate
tools.description: Validate a plugin folder's plugin.json against the schema and check the folder structure.

tools.name: guidelines_preflight
tools.description: Run static sandbox, permission, lifecycle and readability checks and link each finding to the docs.

tools.name: plugin_scaffold
tools.description: Create a new plugin folder inside the workspace without overwriting existing files.

tools.name: devplugins_sync
tools.description: Copy a plugin into the client's dev_plugins root, replacing the previous copy. Requires confirm=true; dry_run lists the files.

tools.name: package_zip
tools.description: Run preflight and build the mod.io zip inside the workspace dist folder.

prompts.name: new_plugin
prompts.description: Scaffold a plugin, gate its permissions and leave it validated and preflighted.

prompts.name: fix_preflight
prompts.description: Run guidelines_preflight on a plugin and fix every finding using its docs link.

prompts.name: prepare_submission
prompts.description: Walk the submission checklist and build the zip for the manual mod.io upload.

resources.description: The stubs symbol index served by api_lookup.
The generator's report of inferred and unresolved API surface.
The LuaLS stub file for one documentation page, id being the page path without extension.
